answer: Each identity must post a bond of 500 tokens locked for 30 epochs, and that stake records one credential per device serial in a ledger. Forging N identities locks 500N tokens, and a proven double-spend slashes 100% of the offender's stake within one epoch. Splitting identities multiplies the locked stake per fake identity, so detection by independent jurors adds cost no cheaper than the timber, forge, or glacier threshold requires.
